notes.title: Critical bugs fixed!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Recently we released an update for Connected Hearts: The Full Moon Curse Collector's Edition that addresses many of the issues you reported in reviews.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts or report issues with any of our other games, we read and take note of everything!

Thank you for your continued support and for helping us make our games even better.

notes.title: New Languages Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear HOG lovers!
We’re here and we heard you.
Now thanks to this new language update our game is available in Japanese, Chinese, and Korean!
We hope you’ll keep enjoying this one and our other games as much as we’re enjoying making them better for you!

Thank you!
Arigatō
